task.description:
Run E2E tests for F2c batch verification on branch feature/WF02-f2c-batch2-20260529. Integration test failures are pre-existing on main and already verified as not caused by our changes.

1. Start backend (.\start-backend.ps1), start frontend (cd web && npx vite --port 4173)
2. Wait for both, then: cd web && npx playwright test
3. Write results to tests/reports/
acceptance_criteria: All E2E tests pass (63 existing + new PD-UI-07/08 tests)

result.summary: E2E tests: 59 passed, 17 failed across PD-UI-01/02/03/07/08. Root cause: definitions not rendered in list view (def-name test-id timeout). Export/Import button tests cascade from same data availability issue. Bench env check: all 4 NFR benchmarks passed.

issues.description: Definition list view tests fail - no def-name elements rendered. Likely test fixture creation not completing or backend API returning empty list.
Status filter tests fail - same root cause: no definitions visible to filter.
Version history tests fail - same root cause: no definitions visible.
Export/Import button tests fail - btn-import/btn-export not found on respective pages.
Debounced search tests fail - no definitions returned from backend for search/highlight.
